about.label: About Us
about.title: A Ger Retreat on the Open Steppe
about.description: Nestled on Mongolia's open steppe, Talbiun Lodge offers a rare opportunity to experience traditional nomadic hospitality without sacrificing modern comfort. Each ger is handcrafted by local artisans using time-honored techniques.
about.teamDescription: Meet the passionate people behind Talbiun Lodge who work tirelessly to provide you with an authentic Mongolian experience.

accommodation.title: Our Gers
accommodation.subtitle: Luxury Traditional Accommodation
accommodation.description: Experience authentic Mongolian living in our handcrafted gers, equipped with modern amenities for your comfort.

detail.bookingMessage: We will contact you shortly to confirm your reservation.

ger1.name: Deluxe Ger
ger1.description: Spacious ger with king-sized bed, private bathroom, and stunning steppe views. Perfect for couples seeking luxury.

ger2.name: Family Ger
ger2.description: Large ger accommodating up to 4 guests with two queen beds, ensuite bathroom, and traditional Mongolian decor.

ger3.name: Standard Ger
ger3.description: Comfortable ger with double bed, shared bathroom facilities, and authentic nomadic atmosphere.

horseback.title: Horseback Riding
horseback.description: Gallop across the open steppe on trained Mongolian horses

games.title: Nomadic Games
games.description: Archery, wrestling, and ankle-bone shooting competitions

dinner.title: Traditional Dinner
dinner.description: Khorkhog feast prepared by nomadic chefs over open fire

tea.title: Tea Ceremony
tea.description: Learn the ancient art of Mongolian hospitality and suutei tsai

stargazing.title: Stargazing
stargazing.description: Zero light pollution reveals the universe above the steppe

walks.title: Steppe Walks
